meta.title: WoW Forever Paladin spell ranks, every level 1-60

status_legend.forever: Forever client data (build 1.60.1.70862) as carried by wowsims-forever

source.records: sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go (wowsims's generator bakes in tools/database/overrides; any override comment is copied to the rank's wowsims_overrides: those fields are wowsims's in-game measurements, not client rows)
source.vanilla: cmangos classic-db spell_template (1.12) for vanilla_* fields, npc_trainer_template 21 + npc_trainer rows of class 2 trainers for vanilla_trainer (teach spell -> learned spell through effect 36 LEARN_SPELL)

formulas.value_at_level: BasePoints + PPL * clamp(min(L, scaling_max_level) - scaling_base_level, 0); scaling_max_level 0 = no cap. Computed in float32 as wowsims Effect.AverageAt. Damage/heal amounts keep the fraction; every other amount is floored.
formulas.cost: cost.mana flat; cost.pct_base_mana = pct of base mana (base_mana table in <class>_levels.json); cost.rage in rage (row value / 10); cost.energy; cost.combo_points_min = the finisher needs at least that many; cost.health (Life Tap row has none: wowsims spends amount + Spirit).
formulas.learn_level: SpellLevels.SpellLevel of the rank (client). learned_from.vanilla_trainer gives the vanilla 1.12 trainer level and cost for comparison. 2 Nov notes: training every class ability 1-60 costs 206-207 gold in Forever, so vanilla costs are not Forever costs.
formulas.vanilla_compare: vanilla.changes_vs_vanilla compares learn level, flat cost, cooldowns and each effect's amount at the learn level (vanilla BasePoints+1 .. BasePoints+DieSides, Forever tooltip range) with the 1.12 row of the same id. A difference of 1 point or less is ignored. Cast times and durations are not compared (the 1.12 rows store index ids into tables not in the local data).
formulas.required_stance_mask: client StanceMask bit field (1 << (form id - 1)); e.g. warrior Battle 17, Defensive 18, Berserker 19; druid Cat 1, Bear 5, Dire Bear 8, Moonkin 31.

coefficient_penalties.finding: Neither wowsims-forever nor mythicsim-forever-engine applies the vanilla sub-20 penalty (1 - (20 - spellLevel)*0.0375) or a downrank coefficient penalty. Ranks learned below 20 carry sp_coef_if_vanilla_sub20_penalty so a sim can switch the vanilla rule on.
coefficient_penalties.forever_notes: kami-labs summary of the 2 Nov 2026 notes: the low-rank penalty was removed from several chance-based talents and stays on Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost (proc less often when the rank was learned more than 12 levels below the caster). Nothing in the notes speaks to damage/heal coefficients of low ranks.

forever_class_notes: Holy Strike (6), Blessing of Kings and Consecration (20) baseline; Righteous Fury at 10; Judgement keeps the seal; Judgement debuffs 40 s; 5-minute blessings and Greater Blessings last 1 hour; Blessing of Might rank 7 133 AP; Seal of Fury new (Warcraft Tavern 21 Sep, 4 Nov notes).
Removed in Forever: Blessing of Light, Blessing of Salvation, Greater Blessing of Salvation/Light, Revoke (4 Nov notes).
notes_sources: Warcraft Tavern summaries of Blizzard's Forever class deep dives: Priest & Warrior (1 Oct 2026, Blizzard news 24301514), Mage & Shaman (7 Oct, 24302097), Rogue & Warlock (7 Oct, 24310968); 'All Changes to Paladins' (21 Sep 2026); 'WoW Forever Pre-Launch Class Changes & Bug Fixes' (4 Nov 2026, from Kaivax's Beta Development Notes updated 2 Nov).
Blizzard news 'World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives - Hunter and Druid' (news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301515).
kami-labs 'WoW Forever November 2 patch: 223 changes before launch' (datamined items marked).
The Blizzard forum dev-notes thread itself could not be fetched here (needs approval); its content is taken from the summaries above.
Where a note and a client row disagree, the row wins; the row values are the ones in ranks[].

notes: Baseline for every Paladin at level 20 in Forever (vanilla: Holy talent). Warcraft Tavern: rank 5 deals 312 damage over 8 s to the first 4 targets and 96 to the rest; spell power 9.5% per tick. Client rows (ConsecrationTriggered 1280349): per tick 12 to every target (no coefficient) + 27 at sp_coef 0.042 (the first-4 part), i.e. 39 x 8 = 312 and 12 x 8 = 96: the damage agrees, the coefficient is 0.042 per tick in the row, not 9.5%; the row wins.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: The mark the ground lays on the first enemies inside it, one aura per enemy: the bonus tick's dummy, and Consecrated Ground's Holy damage from caster mod, whose points the server sets from the talent. The area trigger keeps it up while the ground stands, so it outlives the last tick by the row's 0.6 sec. Consecration https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=20924 Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 96 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 216 damage over 8 sec. The ground ticks once a period after the cast, none at the cast. Each tick rolls spell hit and crit on its own, though no row in the ladder states Periodic Can Crit. The ground marks the enemies inside it, up to the bonus targets, and keeps every mark up for the time it has left and the mark's tail: at the cast, and at each tick for an enemy that came later. The bonus scales on its own coefficient, so it is added to the base damage here rather than through the dot's, which is the base tick's and states none: the spell power and the Holy damage the target takes extra both sit inside the tick's base. The marked enemies take it. The cast rolls its own hit only so that procs on a resist can fire; the ground is laid whether it lands or not. The roll counts nothing, so the row's Miss % is the ticks' own.

The rank of a paladin aura as sim/core/buffs wants it: the spell the paladin cast and its rank. The castable aura spell: instant, on the GCD, free. The aura it turns on is one of the self-cast paladin auras in sim/core/buffs, which already sit in PaladinAuraCategory so one cast replaces the last.
Devotion Aura https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=10293 Gives 735 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Divine Favor (talent) https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=20216 When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance. The crit and the one charge the next Holy Light, Flash of Light or Holy Shock spends are the row's. The cast spends the charge whether or not it lands, so a resisted Holy Shock, or one a Light's Vigil turns into its strike, spends it too.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: [procConfig.Flags &^= core.SpellFlagHelpful] The row's first effect is the block chance on the paladin. | [procConfig.ThreatMultiplier = 1.2] The tooltip's 20% additional threat. || Holy Shield (talent) https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=1239570 Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 221 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges. The per-block damage has no row of its own: it is the shield's own proc-trigger-damage effect. Shieldsworn: a Holy Strike that lands with a shield deals the shield's damage and spends no charge. That damage reports as its own copy of the spell, tagged with the talent. Steadfast Libram: more block value while the shield is up. The row requires a shield, which the cast requirement checks.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Holy Shock (talent) https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=20930 Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 334 to 362 Holy damage to an enemy, or 307 to 333 healing to an ally. One of the rank's two spells off the cast row, with the effect row's id, defense type, class flags, spell power coefficient and roll. Magic reads the coefficient and the roll off the cast row, which states neither. In game the heal makes 0.25 threat a point healed, as Holy Light does. The damage makes full threat. Boundless Light: more crit on an ally without the paladin's Oath of Light.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Holy Strike https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=10333 An instant strike that causes 50% weapon damage plus an additional 97 to 121 as Holy damage. The row states the flat part as its normalized-weapon-damage effect and the percentage as a second effect, and the percentage scales the flat part too: the 2 to 4 is Rank 1's 12 ± 1.5 at 25%. The spell power coefficient sits on the flat effect, but the paladin's own spell power goes through the weapon percent, as it does for the Seal of Command proc: Rank 3's 0.429 at 32% is 0.137 per point of spell power. The damage-against-mob-type gear is added after the percent at the full coefficient, and the Holy damage the target takes extra, Judgement of the Crusader, is taken at the full coefficient after the done multipliers, where core adds it. No BonusCoefficient: the spell power goes through the weapon percent, so the strike adds it by hand below rather than letting CalcDamage add it on top.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Seal of Command (talent) https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=20920 Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 194 to 211 Holy damage, 388 to 422 if the target is stunned or incapacitated. The game files state the stunned number, and the game halves it otherwise. The judgement's damage sits on the spell its own dummy names, which the family's triggered ladder carries one rank above the proc. The proc spell 20424 has no rank subtext and heads that ladder: its 70% of weapon damage and the 0.29 coefficient on that same effect are read from it, and 7 procs per minute is the number the Classic sim carries. The coefficient sits on the weapon-percent effect, and the percent applies to the paladin's own spell power as well as the weapon: at 27 spell power the Forever beta measured 5.5 of each proc coming from spell power, 20.4%, against the 29% the coefficient states. Improved Seals raises the percent itself (the tooltip reads 80% with the talent, 70 * 1.15). The Holy damage the target takes extra, Judgement of the Crusader and the damage-against-mob-type gear, is added after the percent at the full coefficient, so it scales at 29% whatever the talent. Melee in SpellCategories with No Active Defense: hit and crit on the melee table, never dodged, parried or blocked. The judgement's dummy states no class flags; the damage spell it names does, and modifiers find the judgement by those. 20424 carries Not a Proc: it is an ability hit to every listener, weapon procs included. No BonusCoefficient: the spell power goes through the weapon percent, so the proc adds it by hand below rather than letting CalcDamage add it on top. The Holy damage the target takes extra is taken at the full coefficient after the done multipliers, where core adds it. The seal and its Echo roll the same chance: an Echo of Command "empowers your next melee attack with a chance to activate Seal of Command". The Echo's stored copies ignore the seal's 1 sec ICD and do not start it, so a spend of three copies roll
The seals' rows as the game files state them. Seal of Command is a talent and registers from registerTalentSpells.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: The damage spell each rank fires on a hit. They carry no rank subtext, so no ladder holds them, and the store carries no row for them, so the proc is built by hand. Seal of Righteousness https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=20293 Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack additional Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 187 to 203 Holy damage to an enemy. The seal's second effect names its judgement (the row has no effect at the game files' index 1). The judgement's dummy, its second effect, carries the number the per-hit damage is built from: the seal's tooltip renders that number over 87 and over 25, which is the flat "value per hundred times swing speed" at speeds 1.15 and 4.0. Its description variables add the spell power part, $1h=${0.0765*$SPH} to the low end and $2h=${0.12*$SPH} to the high end. The damage spells carry no spell power coefficient, and the judgement dummy's per-rank coefficient (0.058 to 0.2) is not read. proc = value/100 * speed * hand(speed) + coefficient * (spell power + Judgement of the Crusader) two-hander:  hand = 1.2,                                  coefficient 0.12 one-hander:  hand = 0.85 - 0.2 * max(0, 2.0 - speed),     coefficient 0.1 The hand factors were measured on the 1.60.1 beta at level 20, ranks 1-3, eighteen weapons from 1.7 to 3.7 (2026-09-26). The two-hander line is exact from 2.6 to 3.7. One-handers sit on 0.85 from 2.0 up and lose a little per tenth of a second below that: 0.83 at 1.9, 0.81 at 1.8, 0.79 at 1.7, which is as fast as the test could reach; the straight line through those is one of two shapes the data allows and they agree to a percent down to 1.5. The spell power part takes one coefficient per hand type at every speed and rank, outside the fast-weapon penalty, and Judgement of the Crusader counts as spell power at the same coefficient. A crit doubles the unrounded total. The coefficients were measured on the 1.60.1.70425 beta at level 30, rank 4, at 0 and 50 spell power (2026-10-16). wowsims_code_notes.comment: Seal of Command (talent) https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=20920  Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 194 to 211 Holy damage, 388 to 422 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.  The game files state the stunned number, and the game halves it otherwise. The judgement's damage sits on the spell its own dummy names, which the family's triggered ladder carries one rank above the proc. The proc spell 20424 has no rank subtext and heads that ladder: its 70% of weapon damage and the 0.29 coefficient on that same effect are read from it, and 7 procs per minute is the number the Classic sim carries.  The coefficient sits on the weapon-percent effect, and the percent applies to the paladin'
